content.text: [annoyed] I'm not going to send the private key over Telegram. Anyone who gets that file gets into every server it opens, and chat logs stick around. Use AirDrop or a password manager to move it, or make a new key on this laptop with `ssh-keygen -t ed25519` and add the public key to your servers. I can help with either, or find the key file if it's already on this Mac.
